name: sourcegraph_search
description: Search public open-source code on the internet via Sourcegraph (grep.app's API is Vercel-blocked for non-browser clients). Not this repository: for local project source use repo_search. Returns repo/path/line snippets. E.g. query=readSliceShort lang=zig to see real-world Zig usage.
